chants.notes: PRINTED chant of the day: p623 prints 'IN. Cognovi, et alii cantus ut supra die 16 novembris.' 17 November prints no page for it; p525 is taken from the 16 November line 'IN. Cognovi, Domine, 525.' 16 November carries two Masses (S. Margaritae Scotiae, then Eodem die S. Gertrudis); the named incipit Cognovi identifies Margaret's, since Gertrude's introit is Dilexisti iustitiam. Ruled by the user 2026-09-05.
